subject: Delta Therapies — compliance clearance & exec discount request
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>; Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Delta Therapies — initial compliance flag + discount request

Hi team,

Spoke with Lena (Delta Therapies) this morning. They want to accelerate a POC and have asked for a 40% first-year discount and a 6-month pilot SLA at our "Dedicated" tier. Commercially it's appealing, but their corporate structure shows a set of subsidiaries operating in a restricted jurisdiction flagged by our export controls.

Lena says procurement will sign quickly if we can (a) confirm we can service them without export violations and (b) accept the discount. They've already shared a filled vendor DD form (attached) and dropped a SOC2 report.

Can legal / deal desk advise required clearance steps and whether we should escalate the 40% discount to execs? If we need KYC/identity verification or a tailored export review, can we loop in Compliance?

Attachments: Delta_DueDiligence_Form.pdf, SOC2_report_Q4_2026.pdf

Next steps I propose:
- Marissa: confirm discount approval threshold and whether this requires Deal Desk + Exec sign-off
- Laura: quick read on export flags + required evidentiary items
- Steph: optional, if you want to prep an exec summary for aditya_rao

Thanks,
Ben
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>; Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-28T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Delta Therapies — initial compliance flag + discount request

Thanks Ben — quick read.

Summary of issues:
- Their DD form discloses an operating entity in a country that appears on our controlled export list. The form is incomplete for beneficial ownership of that entity (missing UBOs and ultimate jurisdiction of incorporation).
- SOC2 looks standard but doesn't address data residency for the subsidiary.

What I need to clear:
1) Completed KYC: UBO declaration and local entity incorporation docs
2) Customer answer on intended processing location for Redwood-hosted workloads (will they host in our US region only?)
3) Confirmation Delta will accept a contractual export-control warranty and an audit clause

If Delta can provide the KYC + commit to US-only hosting for the POC, I think we can proceed with a technical clearance but need Deal Desk sign-off on the pricing concession. If they refuse US-only hosting or refuse KYC items, we should treat this as a hard stop pending Exec review.

I'll draft suggested warranty language but this will need to go in a redline prior to signature.

-L
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>; Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>; Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-29T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Delta Therapies — initial compliance flag + discount request

Team,

Ben please confirm the exact commercial ask in writing for the exec note. I drafted a short summary below we could use for aditya. Please review and flag anything to add:

- Account: Delta Therapies (early-stage biotech)
- Ask: 40% first-year discount on Dedicated capacity; 6-month pilot with SLA; acceptance of Redwood standard DPA with possible redlines
- Risk: Customer group includes entity in restricted jurisdiction (export control flag); incomplete KYC/UBO data; uncertain data residency commitments
- Mitigation proposed: KYC and UBO disclosure prior to provisioning, contractual export warranty limiting use/residency to US region for pilot, holdback clause in contract until export checks complete
- Recommendation: Escalate pricing concession (40%) to Execs for approval conditional on KYC + US-only processing commitment

If that's accurate, Marissa please confirm whether Deal Desk can approve anything up to 25% or whether this must go to aditya_rao. If it goes to execs, I'll prepare a one-pager and include Laura's suggested warranty text.

-Steph
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>; Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-29T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Delta Therapies — initial compliance flag + discount request

Thanks — Deal Desk policy: discounts over 30% require Exec approval. 40% is outside delegated authority.

I recommend escalating with the following ask for Execs:
- Approve one-time 40% introductory discount for first year only (renewal at standard pricing)
- Approval conditioned on: completed KYC/UBO, contractual export warranty (US-only for pilot), and a refundable holdback equal to one month prepayment until compliance docs received

If you send the exec packet I'll route to aditya_rao and add a recommended timeline (72 hours) due to the customer's timeline.

-Marissa
Senior Deal Desk Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>; Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>; Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-01T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Exec approval request: Delta Therapies (DLT-2027-091) — 40% first-year discount (conditional)

Aditya,

Attached is a short exec packet for Delta Therapies. Key points:
- Commercial ask: 40% first-year discount on Dedicated capacity, 6-month pilot SLA.
- Risk: Group contains an entity in an export-restricted jurisdiction; KYC/UBO incomplete; data residency for that subsidiary unconfirmed.
- Condition for approval (if granted): Completed KYC & UBO disclosure, contractual export-control warranty to restrict pilot processing to US region, and one-month refundable holdback until compliance docs delivered.
- Timeline: customer is requesting a contract signature within the week.

Please let me know if you approve the conditional discount. If you prefer alternative mitigations (e.g., escrow instead of holdback), note that in your reply and we'll adapt.

Attachments: Delta_DueDiligence_Form.pdf, SOC2_report_Q4_2026.pdf

-Steph
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>; Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>; Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>; Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-03T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec approval request: Delta Therapies (DLT-2027-091) — 40% first-year discount (conditional)

Thanks for the packet — I reviewed. I approve a one-time 40% first-year discount subject to the following hard conditions:
1) Delta provides completed KYC with UBO disclosure (validated by our third-party KYC provider)
2) Contract includes an export-control warranty restricting POC processing to US-based Redwood regions for the pilot period
3) One-month refundable holdback or equivalent escrow until compliance docs are validated

If Delta refuses or cannot satisfy these conditions, we will not proceed. Marissa, please update pricing approval notes in the deal record and route the amended contract when ready. Laura, please prepare the warranty clause and the short audit right language.

Aditya Rao
VP, Finance & Operations, Redwood Inference
